title: France issue-to-source candidate index
description: Candidate locator only. Static presence does not mean a source was consulted in an applicant answer, applies to the facts, is binding, or is current.

consultation_use_rule.currentness_rule: Recheck the publisher and displayed version/date for the individual consultation; a candidate record, link review, package version, or stored snapshot does not establish currentness or consultation.

issues.relevance: Use to identify French operational guidance and potentially relevant French national-law or decision candidates for a France EU-family entry-visa question. Assess legal scope and current text separately.
exclusions: France-Visas guidance is operational guidance, not a substitute for Directive or statutory text.
The Nantes joined decision is a fact-specific first-instance decision from 2021 under pre-recodification law; do not automate precedent or applicability conclusions.

issues.relevance: Candidate for an ordinary short-stay Visa Code refusal and France RAPO route only.
exclusions: Do not apply this route automatically to a Directive 2004/38 EU-family entry-visa refusal.
Check current official procedure, competent body, scope and time limits before advice.

issues.relevance: Candidate statutory and case-law materials for conditional interim-suspension screening when urgency and a serious legal doubt may be relevant.
exclusions: Not an eligibility determination or guarantee of relief.
Verify the exact proceeding, national procedure, urgency, merits and any interaction with administrative appeal from current official sources.
Do not infer urgency from an appeal deadline alone.
